events.title: The First Dragon
events.description: Search for traces of the First Dragon and his descendants. Find out if there is more to the tale of a beautiful festive garment that has been lost ever since it fell into its claws.

events.title: Valentine's Day
events.description: Romantic times! Buy Valentine's cakes, flower bouquets, heart backpacks and other romantic items for your loved one from Valentina in Greenshore.
